result:
**Short answer:** The *active* visit is the patient's open encounter-visit on the server: the most recent visit with no `stopDatetime`. The *current* visit is what the UI treats as "the visit in play". It is the active visit unless the user has picked a retrospective (past) visit, in which case that visit is current. With no active visit and no retrospective selection, there is no current visit. In the chart, the `visitContext` store value is the practical successor to `currentVisit`.

**Definitions (documented in code):** The authoritative definition is the JSDoc on `useVisit` in openmrs-esm-core. It defines both terms and says the two need separate API calls (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts` lines 32-52). The `currentVisit` and `currentVisitIsRetrospective` fields are marked `@deprecated`, with the note that "current visit" is not well defined outside the patient chart and that `visitContext` should be used there (same file, lines 12-30).

**Implementation:**
- Active visit: fetched with `includeInactive=false` and filtered to `stopDatetime === null` (`useVisit.ts` lines 66, 76, 87-90).
- Current visit: taken from the retrospective visit UUID stored in the visit store, only when that store entry belongs to this patient (`useVisit.ts` lines 65, 85, 92-95).
- Current visit ends automatically: when the current visit stops, the context is cleared (`useVisit.ts` lines 98-117).
- Patient chart: `visitContext` is seeded from the active visit when entering the chart, and falls back to the stored context (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts` lines 55-72, 84-94, 156-163).
- Consumers:
  - The visit-context header treats the context as "active" when it has no `stopDatetime`, which controls styling (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visits-widget/visit-context/visit-context-header.extension.tsx` lines 14-30).
  - The "Current visit" summary card renders `visitContext` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visits-widget/current-visit-summary.extension.tsx` lines 12-42). Its header comment says it is not used in the refapp.
  - The banner's "Active Visit" tag uses `activeVisit`, and hides when the chart context is a past visit (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.extension.tsx` lines 13-20).
  - Order posting uses `currentVisit`, so retrospective orders are judged against a visit that has ended (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts` lines 66-81).
  - Visit cache updates treat a visit without `stopDatetime` as the active one (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/visit-mutations.ts` lines 115-117).

**O3 docs:** The docs use the terms without a formal definition. "Active visit" appears in the workspace launch guidance (`openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/workspaces/launching-workspaces.mdx` lines 39, 57), and "current visit" appears in the field-expression docs (`openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-the-patient-chart.mdx` line 142) and the ward-management docs (`openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-ward-management.mdx` line 197). The distinction is only documented in the `useVisit` JSDoc.

**Not verified:** I did not read the visit-context store (`useVisitContextStore`) that holds the retrospective UUID and `visitContext`. The `currentVisit` return line in `useVisit.ts` (around line 138) was seen only in grep output. The search budget ran out before I could confirm the store internals.
